svg.title: Location cycle: coordinates and residence time
svg.desc: Six locations m0 through m5 repeat in order. Three separate panels show continuous physical coordinates at their different scales; the residence-time metadata restarts at zero on every new visit. Dashed vertical segments show exact event ages, not physical state jumps; shaded bands show the active location.
